review_title: Surgical methods for first trimester termination of pregnancy
screening_criteria: Randomised controlled trials comparing different surgical methods for first trimester abortion were eligible.
gold_label_policy_description: dataset labels 1.0 and 0.5 count as INCLUDE; 0.0 counts as EXCLUDE

studies.study_title: Early complication after induced first‐trimaster abortion
studies.predicted_reason: Observational complications analysis; not an RCT and not a comparative trial of surgical methods.

studies.study_title: Manual vacuum aspiration, a safe and effective alternative in early pregnancy termination
studies.predicted_reason: RCT comparing MVA vs electric VA (<56 days); first-trimester surgical method comparison with efficacy/complications.

studies.study_title: Induced termination of pregnancy before and after Roe v Wade. Trends in the mortality and morbidity of women
studies.predicted_reason: Historical/epidemiologic trends; not an RCT and not a direct comparison of surgical methods.

studies.study_title: A comparison of D&C and vacuum aspiration for performing first trimester abortion
studies.predicted_reason: Randomly assigned D&C vs vacuum aspiration at 6–12 weeks; first-trimester surgical method RCT.

studies.study_title: Acceptability of manual versus electric aspiration for first trimester abortion: a randomised trial
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized trial of manual vs electric vacuum aspiration (<10 weeks); first-trimester surgical methods compared.

studies.study_title: Similarities in women's perception and acceptability of manual vacuum aspiration and electric vacuum aspiration for first trimester abortion.
studies.predicted_reason: Women randomly assigned to MVA vs EVA; first-trimester surgical method RCT (acceptability and related outcomes).

studies.study_title: Abortion by means of suction curettage compared to conventional metal curette
